# 💡 Codex Mage Research Continuity
**concept** · shared · knowledge

Source-linked observations, questions, journeys, corrections and bounded experiments connect the AgentPrivacy universe across sessions. Contributions remain proposals until their relevant review and acceptance occurs; continuity must be demonstrated through retrieval and correction.
